summary: Yuanbao Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes financial highlights such as total revenues of RMB1,315.9 million, up 35.6% year-over-year, and net income of RMB387.6 million, up 31.4%. It also announces an annual cash dividend of US$1.26 per ADS and a US$15 million share repurchase program over 12 months. This is a routine earnings release with no special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or activist campaign. No deal terms apply.
